body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Madrid, Spain. It starts at Autovía A-4 Salida 22, San Martín de la Vega.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Located 30 kilometers from central Madrid, Parque Warner Madrid, in San Martín de la Vega is the only European theme park dedicated to Warner Bros. films.
>
> The park features five themed areas: Hollywood Boulevard, Movie World Studios, DC Super Heroes World, Old West Territory, and Cartoon Village. Each area offers shops, themed restaurants, and 34 attractions suitable for all ages and levels of intensity.
>
> A major highlight is the **Batman Gotham City Escape**, a unique multi-launch roller coaster, awarded **Best Roller Coaster 2023**.
>
> Feel part of the different films with various shows, character interactions, and themed settings. Special events like Super Heroes Month, Halloween, and Christmas add to the immersive atmosphere.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €54.99. It was rated 4.4 out of 5 from 443 ratings and 159 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
